name: copilot-usage-insights
description: Track GitHub Copilot premium requests in the VS Code status bar with a hover summary, dashboard, pacing, and optional billing details.

commands.title: Copilot Usage Insights: Toggle Billing View

copilotUsageInsights.refreshIntervalMinu.markdownDescription: How often (in minutes) the extension refreshes your Copilot usage data from GitHub.

enumDescriptions: Use Premium Requests before June 1, 2026, then AI Credits for monthly plans.
Always show the existing Premium Requests view.
Always show the AI Credits view. Before June 1, this is shown as a preview.
copilotUsageInsights.billingView.markdownDescription: Which billing view to show. `auto` keeps Premium Requests before June 1, 2026 and switches monthly plans to AI Credits on June 1.

copilotUsageInsights.threshold.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable color-coded warnings in the status bar when usage exceeds configured thresholds.

copilotUsageInsights.threshold.warning.markdownDescription: Usage percentage at which the status bar turns warning color.

copilotUsageInsights.threshold.critical.markdownDescription: Usage percentage at which the status bar turns critical/error color.

enumDescriptions: No text — show only the graphic visualization
+$0.00 — show only the billed overage amount
copilotUsageInsights.statusBarTextMode.markdownDescription: Text portion of the status bar display. Set to `none` to show only the graphic.

copilotUsageInsights.statusBarGraphicMod.markdownDescription: Graphic/visual portion of the status bar display. Set to `none` to show only text.

enumDescriptions: Text appears to the left of the graphic — e.g. 50% [■■■■□□□□]
Text appears to the right of the graphic — e.g. [■■■■□□□□] 50%
copilotUsageInsights.statusBarTextPositi.markdownDescription: Controls whether the text label appears to the left or right of the graphic when both are enabled.

copilotUsageInsights.segmentedBarWidth.markdownDescription: Number of segments in bar-style graphic modes (segmented, blocks, dots, circles).

copilotUsageInsights.showBillingDetails.markdownDescription: Enable the billing summary and overage details in the dashboard. Requires a one-time `user` scope upgrade when first enabled.

copilotUsageInsights.showCostInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Append the billed cost / net amount (e.g. `· $1.20`) to the status bar text when billing details are available.

copilotUsageInsights.showBillingRequestB.markdownDescription: Show the Requests by Model breakdown from the billing usage endpoint for models with recorded requests, even when billed overage is still $0.00. Disable to hide the model-level table while keeping other billing features available.

copilotUsageInsights.localLogs.enabled.markdownDescription: Read local Copilot agent debug logs to show session-level AI Credits estimates. Disable to use GitHub API aggregate data only.

copilotUsageInsights.localLogs.includeIn.markdownDescription: Also scan VS Code Insiders workspace storage for Copilot agent debug logs.

copilotUsageInsights.localLogs.lookbackD.markdownDescription: Maximum age, in days, of local Copilot chat sessions to include in the AI Credits session list.

copilotUsageInsights.pricing.overrides.markdownDescription: Per-model AI Credits rate overrides. Keys are model IDs; values can include `inputPerM`, `outputPerM`, and `cachedPerM` in credits per million tokens.

enumDescriptions: Show the percent of the monthly AI Credits allowance used.
Show used credits over the monthly allowance, such as 420 / 1000.
Show used credits only, such as 420 cr.
copilotUsageInsights.statusBar.creditsFo.markdownDescription: Status bar format when AI Credits view is active.

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run check
